Chapters guide

Prologue — GTA 6 progression guide

A short opening played as Lucia: a prison counseling session intercut with a flashback to the robbery that put her inside. It introduces Lucia before the story hands over to Jason in the Leonida Keys.

Missions — what sources report

Every walkthrough lists a single mission, 'Prologue'. Outlets fold it into their counts differently: Dexerto's verified mission list (cross-checked by G2A against PC Gamer, GamesRadar+ and PowerPyx) counts it inside Chapter 1's 22 missions, as do KeenGamer and GameRant, while PowerPyx and GTA6Box list it separately before Chapter 1 begins.

What unlocks

  • Introduction to Lucia as a playable character

Warnings & traps

  • Nothing to collect or protect here — the money and vehicle systems have not opened yet

Sources & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Walkthrough: All Chapters and Story Missions in Order — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Source: GTA 6 Full Walkthrough - All Missions — PowerPyx.

Structure is not in dispute, but naming is worth flagging once: every major outlet calls the story divisions 'chapters', not 'acts' — GameRant loosely calls Chapter 5 'the shortest act' in passing, but the Prologue-plus-five-chapters structure is unanimous.
